card.name: And after stop-drug instruction
card.fires_on: The word "and" right after an instruction to discontinue or withhold a named drug, where a second action (institute or initiate treatment) follows. Seen in warnings about hypersensitivity or similar reactions.

modes.label: Stop drug, then treat
modes.description: "and" joins discontinuing or withholding a brand-name drug with starting appropriate therapy.
modes.example: If a serious hypersensitivity reaction occurs, immediately discontinue SILIQ<< and>> initiate appropriate therapy.

modes.label: List joiner in reaction lists
modes.description: A comma or "and" in a list of affected body parts before a following "and/or" item.
modes.example: Angioedema of the face, lips, tongue<<,>> and/or larynx have been reported

card.plain: It marks the point where a label says to stop the drug and then go on to a second step such as starting supportive treatment.
